source.depthReference: Relative TVD; no reference elevations applied
source.surfacePositions: Exact file/API matches to OGD_Wells; no elevation supplied and no fabricated surface extension

methods.runs: Inclusive point-index pairs. Draw only adjacent points within each run, never across runs or separate branches. Runs break at nonfinite geometry, missing/nonincreasing MD, or MD gaps >1000 ft.
methods.pointPrecision: Source Float32 coordinates and metrics rounded to 0.001 ft/degree for compact display JSON; nonfinite metric values are null.
methods.lateralLength: Sum supported incoming station intervals whose endpoint section is Lateral (4), following the existing classifier. mdFt sums delta MD, planFt sums XZ distances, spatialFt sums XYZ distances. These are selected mapped branch measures, not verified completed footage and not total well measured depth. Branch values are not added across alternate paths.
methods.branchSelection: Owan uses reviewed STK1 plus separate VERT and the actual LAT1 MD10008-18450 prefix as recorded connecting context; exact source XYZ endpoint matches are checked and no completed composite is claimed. Others use greatest supported classified lateral MD footage, with LAT1 tie preference. VERT context remains separate and selected; alternative recorded paths are retained but excluded from the default view.
methods.targetClassification: Hawkinson historicalTarget is the numbered well's published historical design from Continental slide 7, not a branch-specific completion or formation pick. Original provisionalGroup/provisionalTargetLabel/targetStatus and depthGrouping fields are retained unchanged for comparison. Other wells remain unclassified.
limits: No target picks, completion intervals, active-branch status or reference elevations are supplied.
Lateral widths and vertical exaggeration are display choices, not physical bore diameters or altered source coordinates.
Selection is a curated visual case list, not proof of historical milestones, legal pilot membership, costs, production or drilling records.

depthGrouping.method: Median lateral relative TVD of each selected branch; split at largest adjacent depth gap, with at least two wells on each side and gap >=30 ft. Eligible branches need >=1000 classified lateral MD feet and >=3 lateral stations.
depthGrouping.warning: User-requested illustrative labels, not formation picks. Relative TVD uses per-well references without elevation correction. Topography/reference elevations and branch choice can change apparent group separation. No confirmed target or completion assignment is made.

source.title: Hawkinson Unit — Continental Resources slide 7
source.hostDocument: EERC briefing, April 8, 2014; Continental Resources presentation material
source.verification: Numbered target rows visually verified against the primary slide; file/API identities matched to the existing OGD well-name records.

publishedDimensions.status: Published schematic/design dimensions; not measured from current mapped surveys.

caveats: Historical design targets belong to numbered wells, not independently verified present-day sidetracks or active completion intervals. The current selected branches remain a display choice.
No formation surfaces, common elevation datum, completed intervals, or branch-specific geological picks are inferred from the historical schematic.
The original depth proxy is retained unchanged for comparison. Its per-well relative TVD split is not a reliable substitute for the cited historical target assignment.
Slide colors encode monitoring/production/microseismic roles, not formations. Three Forks 4 is drawn but none of the 14 numbered wells is assigned to it.
Row order follows the source schematic; it is not a surveyed geographic cross-section or exact well-to-well separation.
